name: Matter Server
author: home-assistant-libs
description: Python Matter Server is a Matter (CHIP) controller exposed over a WebSocket API. It is the backend Home Assistant's built-in Matter integration talks to, letting you commission and control Matter devices. It runs in host network mode (required by Matter for mDNS/IPv6 discovery and on-network commissioning) and has no web UI — it is a WebSocket service on port 5580 that you point the Home Assistant Matter integration at (ws://<host-ip>:5580/ws). Bluetooth commissioning is supported via the host D-Bus socket. Fabric state and PAA certificates are persisted in the data volume.
